subject.title: [Feature]: Discord - auto-inject @mention for guild message replies

question: Should the Discord plugin add a default-off `autoMentionReply` policy that visibly mentions the original guild message author on replies, or should native Discord replies plus `mentionAliases` remain the supported notification behavior?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the requested fix adds notification policy and config surface in an M4 Discord channel, so automation should not choose the product default or notification semantics alone.

options.title: Approve opt-in auto-mention policy
options.body: Add a default-off Discord plugin config with author-ID prefixing, duplicate-mention and broadcast safety checks, docs, tests, and live guild proof.

options.title: Keep current notification model
options.body: Leave native Discord replies and explicit/alias mentions as the supported behavior, then close this as not planned with docs clarifying the boundary.

options.title: Defer for live proof first
options.body: Keep the issue open but require a live multi-bot Discord reproduction and expected notification transcript before accepting new config surface.

recommendation.title: Approve opt-in auto-mention policy
recommendation.body: Add a default-off Discord plugin config with author-ID prefixing, duplicate-mention and broadcast safety checks, docs, tests, and live guild proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the current mentionAliases config path and is the strongest history signal for this Discord notification/config decision.
